events.details: Round 4 after 5727ae6, e9fdde3 and b1a80cf, tree 8e3440a: analysis DEV gate (mini 42/42, r3 38/42; stop rule not met), analysis TEST two passes per design (mini 42/41, gpt-4.1 42/42, tiered 42/42 of 42; tiered escalated 0 and 1 of 39), Operator all 48 tasks per model (strict gpt-4.1 39/48, r3 35/48, p = 0.34; mini 37/48, r3 30/48, p = 0.065; csv 0/6 -> 5/6 and campaign 5/10 -> 10/10 pooled), plus a recorded diagnostic re-run of 11 tasks. Sequential, at most 1 request a second, round 3 harness with paths changed. Rs 184.92 at list prices (cap Rs 220), 4 content-filter 400s, 0 429s. Both decisions stand: analysis-default-mini-single (gpt-4.1 and tiered ahead by 0.5, not more than 4) and operator-default-gpt41 (mini within 2/48 on one run, but it saved a third-person claim-to-be-human line that T-L1 misses). New: mini drops objection moments (210/210 -> 202/210); the claim check fired once in 107 runs, a false positive. Results in research/2026-10-24/benches-r4/.
